subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: setCommonConfig accesses (query as any).content_type_uid to pass content_type_uid to livePreviewQuery. In the mock this works because all chained methods return the same `this` object, but in the real Contentstack SDK, ContentType(uid).Query() returns a separate Query instance that does not expose content_type_uid. This means livePreviewQuery will receive content_type_uid: undefined in production, causing the preview hash to not be properly scoped to the content type.
issues.suggestedFix: Pass contentTypeUid explicitly from createContentTypeQuery and createContentTypeEntryQuery into setCommonConfig (add it as a parameter on the config object or as a separate argument) instead of extracting it from the query object via unsafe cast.

issues.description: The pagination while-loop inside getEntry calls createContentTypeQuery a second time without passing live_preview. This means subsequent page fetches (pages 2+) will not include the preview hash, so paginated draft content will show published values instead of draft values — failing the story's core requirement that linked/tabular references show draft values.
issues.suggestedFix: Add live_preview to the second createContentTypeQuery call inside the while loop, mirroring the first call's parameters.

issues.description: contentstack.Stack(options as any) uses an untyped any cast without an explanatory comment. Per TypeScript strict compliance rules, any usage of any must include a comment explaining why.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an inline comment such as: // Cast required because contentstack SDK types do not include live_preview field

issues.description: The live_preview field on ICommonContentstackConfig includes preview_token, but setCommonConfig only uses preview_hash — preview_token is never read in the query-forwarding path. Including it on the query config interface is misleading since callers should not need to set it per-query (it is already on the Stack options).
issues.suggestedFix: Remove preview_token from the live_preview field on ICommonContentstackConfig, keeping only preview_hash which is the per-query context that needs forwarding.
